title: Fix publish flow failing on every content submission

requirements.text: Fix the backend authorization logic so authenticated Internet Identity users can successfully publish content via the existing `uploadArticle(article)` method, while still preventing anonymous callers from publishing.

quotes: It's failing to publish content everytime I try, please fix it.

acceptanceCriteria: When a signed-in user submits content from the Publish Content page, the backend call `uploadArticle(article)` completes successfully and persists the article.
Anonymous callers (no Internet Identity session) cannot publish and receive a clear authorization error from the backend.
Existing admin-only restrictions (e.g., deleting articles) remain restricted to admins only.

requirements.text: Improve error handling in the Publish Content page so that when publishing fails, the UI shows the actual backend error message (when available) instead of always showing a generic failure message.

quotes: It's failing to publish content everytime I try, please fix it.

acceptanceCriteria: If publishing fails due to authorization (or any backend trap), the Publish Content page displays a user-visible error message derived from the thrown error (fallback to a generic message only if none is available).
The error message is displayed in English and is visible without requiring the user to open devtools.
The form remains usable after an error (user can correct and retry).

requirements.text: Ensure that a successfully published submission becomes visible in the article feeds immediately after publishing (Home/News queries refresh appropriately) and that the success state is only shown after the publish mutation truly succeeds.

quotes: It's failing to publish content everytime I try, please fix it.

acceptanceCriteria: After a successful publish, navigating to Home and/or News shows the newly published article without requiring a hard refresh.
The “Published Successfully!” confirmation screen is only shown when the upload mutation succeeds (not on failed attempts).

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in `backend/main.mo` (no additional backend services).
Do not edit files under `frontend/src/components/ui` or other frontend immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: Adding a new approval workflow or admin review process for user submissions.
Implementing third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity is supported).
Adding external databases or non-Internet-Computer storage.
